definitions.gloss: friendly rivalry; mutual improvement through competition
definitions.explanation: The process of improving oneself through healthy competition and mutual encouragement with others. Originally refers to the polishing of gemstones, used metaphorically for self-improvement.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To improve through friendly rivalry as a team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I grew by pushing each other with my peers.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}した→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: By competing with our rivals, both sides improved their skills.

notes:
USAGE:
{切磋琢磨|せっさたくま} is a four-character compound (yojijukugo) used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. It always implies a positive, constructive kind of competition — not hostile rivalry.

ETYMOLOGY:
From a passage in the Chinese classic "Book of Songs" ({詩経|しきょう}). {切|せつ} (to cut), {磋|さ} (to file), {琢|たく} (to chisel), {磨|ま} (to polish) — four stages of working raw materials into fine objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to improve through friendly competition
- {切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: the spirit of mutual improvement
- ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to push each other to improve
